pegMechanism: Bank-issued dollar token with KYC-gated mint and redemption through Telcoin banking rails

genius.issuerEntity: Telcoin, Inc. d/b/a Telcoin Digital Asset Bank
genius.stateRegulator: Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance
genius.notes: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank holds a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository Institution charter (signed November 12, 2025) under the Nebraska Financial Innovation Act. The company has publicly committed to publishing monthly reserve attestations from an external auditor, but no published attestation reports were found as of 2026-06-07. News sources characterize eUSD as operating in alignment with the GENIUS Act, but no direct issuer statement announces a GENIUS PPSI application, and no state-regime comparability determination has been made for Nebraska under the GENIUS Act Treasury NPRM. The Nebraska DADI charter is a state banking authorization, not a GENIUS Act PPSI authorization. Retaining no-public-authorization-found as the conservative and accurate status.

Federal Register and OCC/FDIC/FinCEN GENIUS Act NPRMs — no issuer-specific PPSI approvals granted to any entity as of 2026-06-07
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No GENIUS Act PPSI approval, official application, or state-qualified GENIUS authorization was found for Telcoin Digital Asset Bank or eUSD. The Nebraska DADI charter (November 2025) is a state banking authorization under the Nebraska Financial Innovation Act, not a GENIUS Act authorization. The GENIUS Act state-regime comparability process (Treasury NPRM FR 2026-06489) has not designated Nebraska as a substantially similar regime. No GENIUS Act PPSI approvals have been granted to any issuer as of June 7, 2026.

mintAuthority.summary: eUSD is issued by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank under a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository charter; the bank mints eUSD against USD deposits and Treasuries and burns on redemption through KYC-gated banking rails.

controls.label: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank issuance backend
controls.evidence: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank minted the initial eUSD supply directly on Ethereum and Polygon and lets account holders mint/redeem against USD deposits and short-term Treasuries; supply is bank-controlled with no permissionless mint route.

review.evidence: Telcoin announcements describe the chartered bank minting eUSD as a bank-issued dollar stablecoin backed 1:1 by USD deposits and Treasuries with KYC-gated mint/redeem; no user-collateralized or permissionless mint exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the bank-issuer model in Telcoin materials; the on-chain owner/minter admin for the shared eUSD contract address across chains was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/minter admin for the eUSD contract (Ethereum/Base/Polygon) and the Solana mint authority before raising confidence.
